entry.name: mc.twist~
entry.description: The twist~ object accepts a ramp between 0 and 1 (such as one generated by phasor~) and produces a piecewise linear approximation of an expoential function using the same algorithm as the curve~ object. The curvature of the ramp is controlled by the curve attribute that ranges from -1 to 1. A curve value of 0 produces an output ramp identical to the input.

attributes.name: curve
attributes.digest: Curvature
attributes.description: Theattribute sets the parameters of the exponential function that generates the non-linear output. It can range between -1 and 1. For ascending ramps, values ofless than 1 produce values above the linear input and values ofgreater than 1 produce values below the linear input. Asvalues near -1 or 1, the curavture becomes more extreme.
